# Data notice

F-12's production log of September 2010 (a shut-in pass and two flowing passes) as
interpreted LAS files from Volve's `Well_logs_pr_WELL/15_9-F-12/10.PRODUCTION LOGS/PLT Sept
2010/`, with every third depth row kept to stay small; and `production_log_plots.json`, the
reading of F-12's production-log plots (the 2009 interpretation report's Appendices B-D and
the 2010 plot) by `wellpilot.ingest.log_plots`. A test fixture for
`wellpilot.ingest.production_logs` and the `production_log` tool.

Contains data from the Volve field dataset, made available by Equinor and the former Volve
license partners (ExxonMobil Exploration & Production Norway AS, Bayerngas Norge AS) under
the Equinor Open Data Licence:
https://www.equinor.com/content/dam/statoil/documents/what-we-do/Equinor-HRS-Terms-and-conditions-for-licence-to-data-Volve.pdf
